caption:
Dust and oxidized copper. Just a few more inches of crawling until the exhaust. Then my neural link decided I needed a 'moment of zen' and swapped the grimy duct for a blindingly white, spa-like void. It’s a very polite way to have a panic attack. I’m trying not to believe the white walls while my fingernails claw at the actual rust. 🌫️🔧 The hum is growing rhythmic, and EVE can no longer tell if it’s the simulation’s lullaby or the building's mechanical heartbeat.

#NeoTokyo #ArchiveBreach #SystemGlitch #Survival #CyberpunkLife #NeuralLink
